_readme: Every practice value below (name, bio, title, address, price, deposit, product copy) is a PLACEHOLDER invented for local development. The practitioner's real content replaces it before launch (issue 021). The practice page video setting is intentionally not seeded: the page shows its placeholder frame until a real video is configured in settings.

practice._sample_bookings_readme: Local development only: gives the practitioner nine made-up bookings (upcoming, to complete, completed, no-show, cancelled, refunded, partly refunded, disputed, failed) so the Réservations page can be checked without Stripe. Seeded once, when the practitioner has no booking yet.

partner._readme: The practitioner is the administrator, as in the real practice: one account, role administrator, with the practitioner profile verified (what 'Je suis aussi praticien' does). Log in with it to see the five-tab back office with real practitioner pages.
partner.bio: PLACEHOLDER BIO — Ostéopathe D.O., je reçois au cabinet pour des séances d'une heure : douleurs de dos, tensions liées au sport ou au travail, récupération. Chaque séance commence par un échange, puis un traitement adapté.

product.name: Séance d'ostéopathie
product.description: PLACEHOLDER — Une séance d'ostéopathie d'une heure au cabinet.
product._deposit_readme: PLACEHOLDER deposit (acompte): the practitioner's real deposit is unknown. 'fixed' value is cents, 'percent' value is whole percentage points of the price. Remove the field for the full price to be paid online.
